name: Marshall County, MS
findings: Marshall County has 78 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marshall County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
